purpose: Machine-readable theorem-boundary gate for proof-inspired branches.
controller_reason: Only the local BSD surrogate run-contract export is allowed; every formal theorem export is blocked by missing theorem-source data, proof assumptions, and proof-boundary artifacts.

accepted_now.allowed_usage: May cite that the BSD surrogate script ran and reported its mismatch count.
accepted_now.blocker_to_stronger_usage: The engine uses a local parity heuristic, not actual rank or L-function order of vanishing.

blocked_theorem_exports.forbidden_usage: Do not cite this branch as proof of BSD or as a computed BSD verification.
blockers: No source-backed elliptic-curve rank table is attached.
No L-function values or order-of-vanishing computation is performed.
Current surrogate rank indicator mismatches at least one narrated curve role.

blocked_theorem_exports.forbidden_usage: Do not cite library zero checks as proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
blockers: No explicit zero table, precision manifest, or off-critical-line exclusion proof is attached.

blocked_theorem_exports.forbidden_usage: Do not cite Grover/search demos as P-vs-NP resolution.
blockers: No formal reduction, NP-complete benchmark suite, or complexity proof boundary is attached.

blocked_theorem_exports.forbidden_usage: Do not cite bounded Collatz scripts as proof of the conjecture.
blockers: No bounded-search manifest, range declaration, or counterexample policy is attached.

blocked_theorem_exports.forbidden_usage: Do not use quantum-engine demos as theorem-level evidence.
blockers: Deterministic fixtures for norm preservation, gates, Bell states, and entropy are still missing.

claim_boundary: 0.18 can currently export only surrogate/run-contract evidence. All theorem-level exports are blocked.
